payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results related to the detection of cyberbullying using various models and techniques, including the impact of oversampling and transfer learning.

claims.text: Oversampling the bullying class improved the performance of DNN models significantly across evaluation measures, particularly for the smallest dataset, Formspring.
Traditional machine learning models (LR, SVM, RF, NB) performed significantly lower than DNN models in cyberbullying detection.
Transfer learning showed low recall but higher precision, indicating different natures of cyberbullying across datasets.
